svg.aria-label: Sketch: the front lawn of a single-story elementary school on a clear day, its shallow green gable roofs and long siding seen beyond young pines. At right a low split-face stone monument sign with a capped top and a pale inset panel stands on the grass. A curved sidewalk and a driveway sweep in from the left, where a police SUV with a light bar is parked; a gray SUV and a pickup sit farther along the drive. A strip of police tape runs across the whole foreground. No people are shown. Drawn after an NBC News photograph of Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon.
